SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: Demoness embodying threats to children, mothers, pregnancy, and representing primal maternal fears
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The nightmare of motherhood - child death personified, maternal fear given form

Correspondences.Color: Sickly Yellow, Blood Red, Shadow Black

DevelopmentalArc: Divine Daughter → Rebellion → Demoness → Child Predator → Warded Evil

CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Extensive protective rituals against her, amulets for pregnant women and children, birthing chamber wards, incantations, Pazuzu invocations
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Ancient child-death demon, remained feared throughout Mesopotamian history, extensive protective traditions developed, influenced child-threatening demon archetypes worldwide

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted with lion head, donkey ears, bird feet/talons, naked, hairy body, nursing pig and dog, holding serpents, standing in boat, fearsome maternal inversion
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: I am the fear in every mother's heart, the fever that takes children, the death that stalks birth, the nightmare of new life.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: A monstrous mother figure approaching the cradle; nursing demons instead of children; the predator in the birth chamber

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Invoke for understanding primal fears, protection work (against her), shadow of motherhood, confronting child-death anxiety
AIPromptSeeds: Generate the demon who embodies every parent's nightmare - the predator that threatens children and new life.
Create the shadow of the mother goddess - death instead of life, predation instead of nurture.
NarrativeHooks: The demon warded by another demon
